name: Dishoom Covent Garden
address: Dishoom Covent Garden, 12 Upper St Martin's Ln, London WC2H 9FB, United Kingdom
description: Dishoom Covent Garden located on Upper St. Martins Lane, pays loving homage to the Irani cafés that were once part of the fabric of life in Bombay. Begin your day at Dishoom with breakfast, which might be a Bacon Naan Roll, Akuri or The Big Bombay. Then, lunch deliciously on a Paneer Roomali Roll and fancy Salads, or linger with a feast. Refresh your afternoon with a drop of Chai and a small plate or two. Dine early or dine late.
priceLevel: Price per person: £20–60 Reported by 1,880 people

reviews.text: Had such a lovely evening at Dishoom Covent Garden! The food was absolutely delicious, packed with flavour and beautifully presented. The cocktails were fantastic too, really well made and the perfect addition to the meal. The atmosphere was buzzing, with a great vibe, and the staff were genuinely lovely, friendly and attentive. Everything felt spot on from start to finish. Such a brilliant place, I would definitely recommend and can't wait to visit again! One thing I'd definitely recommend is booking a table in advance, as the queues can be absolutely massive if you just turn up! It's clearly a very popular spot, and for good reason.

reviews.text:
had an absolutely glorious meal at dishoom; quite possibly the best indian restaurant i’ve ever been to and i’ve visited so many over the years!

we reached at 5pm on a monday evening and there was already a queue. we finally got our table around 535pm. a bit of the wait but the lemonade given to us by the staff definitely helped :)

we ordered the signature black daal, chicken tikka, mattar paneer, and an item from the kids menu as well for our two year old.

every dish was absolutely delicious and we loved it! the black daal might be too rich for some but we enjoyed it nonetheless and it went so well with the rice and naan as well as the other side dishes.

there’s a lot to try here at dishoom and we will definitely be back again to try the other items! this is a must visit for anyone visiting london as well ☺️

the service here is also fantastic! the staff are warm and friendly and very attentive. the ambience and decor of the place is very lovely and vibrant too, nothing like you’d see in any other indian restaurants!

dishoom team, you should definitely consider opening up an outlet here in singapore where i’m absolutely confident you will do incredibly well! drop me an email if this is within your plans and i’ll be happy to discuss further! (my email address is in my bio)

all the best! 🥳

reviews.text: Wow! Just wow! The second this restaurant opens there is a line out of the door already.  Get your reservation in advance!  We were shocked at the size of this place. There was so much seating.  The atmosphere was amazing- well decorated and fun.  The food, hands down the best Indian food we’ve ever had!  We had the ruby chicken, chicken biryani, and garlic naan and we practically licked our plates clean! Put this on your list of places to visit when you plan your trip, but make a reservation now!
